}}'''Dun Agrath''' is a dwarven village located in the southwestern portion of [[Wetlands|the Wetlands]], just southeast of [[Menethil Harbor]] and west of [[Hawk's Vigil]].

The flight path to Dun Agrath is unlocked when the player discovers the flight path to Menethil Harbor.
